name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and your knees dropped out to the sides.
Hold your feet and let your knees relax toward the floor.
Lean forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch in your inner thighs.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.
image_prompt_scene: Seated with the soles of the feet together and the knees dropped out.
